chunks.text: The Eiffel Tower is in Paris and was completed in 1889.
Paris is known for its cafes, museums, and the Seine river.
Gustave Eiffel also designed the internal frame of the Statue of Liberty.
France uses the euro as its currency since 2002.
The tower attracts around 7 million visitors per year.

cases.question: When was the Eiffel Tower completed?

chunks.text: Photosynthesis converts CO2 and water into glucose using sunlight.
Chlorophyll is the pigment that gives plants their green color.
The Calvin cycle runs in the stroma of chloroplasts.
Cacti open stomata at night to reduce water loss.
Mitochondria produce ATP through cellular respiration.

cases.question: Where does the Calvin cycle run?

chunks.text: PostgreSQL 15 added the MERGE command for upserts.
Indexes speed up queries but slow down writes.
Connection pooling reduces the cost of new connections.
Logical replication streams row changes to subscribers.
